rationale: The primary cell is a structural null dominated by gate-signal saturation in the LOW direction (threat 11, opposite of the pilot): the tau sweep shows realized entropy 0.0 on 8/10 instances (all five strategy proposals merged into one NLI cluster at entailment threshold 0.7), branch_rate 0.2 at tau=0, and realized k=1 on eight instances. H1 rarefied distinct gain is exactly 0.0 (exact sign-flip p=1.0 against a tie-imposed min_achievable_p of 0.5 from 8 zero gains), so the fixed-sequence gate is closed and H2 (-0.1, p=1.0, floor 0.25) is descriptive. The supporting checks are clean: nonempty_patch_fraction 1.0/1.0 (no productivity confound), no k-mismatch, realized N=5 on all instances (no grid exclusions), and the control's token total (3,306,783) >= the treatment's (3,198,566), so the null is not a starved-control or accounting artifact. This is not a noise-dominated result that a seed2 repeat would clarify -- the headline number is pinned near zero by mechanism non-engagement, and a repeat draw would mostly re-measure that same saturation; temperature cells are premature before the mechanism story is anchored. The SDLG cell is the single most informative next draw because it replaces the only component the null implicates -- the strategy proposer -- with a confidence-independent generator that forces semantic diversity by gradient-guided token substitution, disambiguating 'the proposer's five strategies are semantically mode-collapsed (or the intent-summary clustering over-merges them)' from 'branching cannot beat matched-k resampling on this substrate at all'; R5.4's off-mode-recovery analysis also requires this arm regardless. The lone descriptive hint of the premise (on sympy-15345, the one multi-branch instance, treatment pairwise patch distance 0.994 vs vanilla 0.015) makes the mechanism contrast more, not less, worth anchoring.
expectations: If the SDLG arm branches substantially (realized k >> 1) and shows a positive rarefied distinct gain over its matched-k control, the story is that the entropy-gated framework works when the generator is confidence-independent and the strategy-proposal arm's null was generator-level mode collapse (or NLI over-merging of its intents) -- which paradoxically supports the mode-collapse premise while indicting the proposal mechanism. If SDLG branches but shows no distinct-patch or coverage gain, forced upstream semantic diversity does not propagate to distinct final patches, which undermines the headline mechanism generally. If even SDLG's forced-diverse alternatives collapse to one intent cluster (entropy ~0 again, k ~1), the intent-summary clustering substrate / entailment threshold 0.7 is over-merging and the gate signal -- not the generators -- is the broken component; the paper then reports the gate as uninformative at this substrate per threat 11. All three outcomes are exploratory and change what the paper says about mechanism; none can alter the confirmatory H1/H2 record, which stands as a null in the pre-registered cell.
